follow-up time: From >20 weeks gestation to delivery (April 2007 to March 2010)
outcome: maternal complications (gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, preterm premature rupture of membranes, etc.)
delivery complications (caesarean delivery, shoulder dystocia, postpartum haemorrhage, etc.)
finding: Overweight/obese depressed pregnant women experienced the highest odds of both maternal and delivery complications.
mod_finding: The study found that overweight/obese depressed pregnant women had higher odds of delivery complications, including caesarean delivery.
